$comment: The First Voyage (docs/design/first-voyage.md): a new captain's first chapters, taught by the quartermaster. The cay a storm wrecked a sloop on lies 'cayTiles' (from, to) from the home port's berth, by sea, on water within 'shoreTiles' of land (of a cay, an island under 'islandTiles' tiles, where the home waters have one), and at least 'clearOfPortsTiles' from every port and haven (so Space there is the salvage, not a port); it is named for the home nation in 'cays'. She has reached it within 'arriveTiles' of the wreck. The wreck's 'salvage' is casks of its good, the least number (at least 'minUnits') whose sale at home covers 'cover' times what a full battery costs beyond her purse, and 'men' castaways who join her. Then her first prize: a pirate 'pirate' (no great guns, a green crew, no resolve) harrying a fishing 'boat' 'offTiles' off the wreck, circling it 'orbitTiles' out at 'radPerSecond'; meek in battle, she strikes once her hull or crew falls below 'meek' of what she had, and never boards, flees or sinks. Freed, the boat sails home by the lanes.
